summary: Sends Starboard's events to email, Telegram, Discord and more in plain words, plus a weekly summary.
does: Notifications sends messages about what happens on your server, in plain words. Channels are email, Telegram, Discord, Signal, Pushover, ntfy or a webhook, and you activate the ones you want.

You choose what to send: a request that is ready to watch, a failed download, an app that stops answering, a disk nearly full, disk changes, an update, and a weekly New this week with what arrived in the last 7 days.
for: For people who want to hear about their server without opening it, such as when something they requested is ready, an app has stopped, or a disk is filling up.
needs: At least one channel set up with its own details, such as an email server, a Telegram bot token or a Discord webhook. The ready-to-watch message needs Seerr or Reelix requests set up in Starboard, and says it is ready in Jellyfin. Needs plug-in API 1.14 or later.
shows: Two dashboard cards: Notifications, the last message sent and by which channels, and Notifications sent, the last 10 messages newest first. Its tab has what to send, the day for New this week, and a section for each channel.
